problem: Poisson 2D manufactured solution u=sin(pi x)sin(pi y) on [0,1]^2
audit_gap: m14490 §1.5: sipg_matrixfree.py and sipg_sparse.py had no benchmark artifacts

observations.accuracy_equivalence: All three backends produce identical solutions (relative L2 agrees to ~1e-14)
observations.small_grid_performance: For 4x4 (64 DOFs): dense fastest (0.026s), sparse slowest (0.59s) due to scipy overhead
observations.medium_grid_performance: For 8x8 (256 DOFs): sparse fastest (0.044s), dense slower (0.21s), matrix-free slowest (1.59s)
observations.scaling_note: Matrix-free PCG iteration count grows with DOFs (12→47); for larger grids the memory advantage becomes significant
observations.recommendation: Use dense for small problems (<100 DOFs), sparse for medium problems (100-10000 DOFs), matrix-free for large problems (>10000 DOFs) where memory is the bottleneck
